Approval to NCLP forThane and
Solapur
*421. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had accorded
approval to the National Child Labour Projects
under the Child Labour (P&R) Act, 1986 for
Thane and Solapur in 1995 and for 11 other
districts in the years 2003  and 2004;
(b) if so, the details thereof, the facilities
and support provided to child labour
thereunder and the number of children
covered in Maharashtra under the scheme;
(c) whether Government of
Maharashtra has proposed some more
districts in the State to be covered under
the National Child Labour Projects;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) Government's reaction thereto?
Provision of telephones in tribal
villages of Andhra Pradesh
*422. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether all the tribal villages have
been provided with telecommunication
facilities in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof, location-
wise and district-wise;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government have set any
target to provide said facilities to all the
tribal villages in Andhra Pradesh?
Exemption from toll tax
†*423. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Rajasthan has requested for providing
exemption to the Parliamentarians and the
131

132
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Legislators from payment of toll tax on
National Highways in Rajasthan; and
(b) if so, by when such exemption
would be provided?
Assistance sought by Karnataka
*424. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of SMALL
SCALE INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Karnataka
has sought assistance for upgradation of
existing Tool Room and Training Centre at
Hassan and for improvement of
productivity and quality of Kolhapuri
footwear cluster at Athani, Belgaum
district, under the Small Industry Cluster
Development Programme; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
the Central Government's reaction thereto?
Pending irrigation projects
†*425. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of pending irrigation
projects to make availability of water for
irrigation of agricultural land;
(b) the amount needed for remaining
period of Tenth Plan and the Eleventh Plan
period to solve the problems of pending
irrigation projects, development of waste
land and drought affected areas, State-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that the States
have refused to contribute for big projects
in the meeting of the National Development
Council; and
(d) if so, in what manner Government
propose to manage and make provisions of
funds for the above projects?
Payment of compensation to Indians
by Myanmar
*426. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to refer to the answer
to Unstarred Question 2275 given in the
Rajya Sabha on 12th December, 2002 and
state:
(a) the details of meetings held between
India and Myanmar since 2003 onwards
on the issue of payment of compensation
to Indians by Myanmar;
(b) the details of cases settled and those
not settled, so far;
(c) the steps being taken for early
settlement of the remaining cases; and
(d) by when all the cases are likely to be
settled?
Privatisation of employment
exchanges
*427. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Planning Commission has
suggested privatising employment
exchanges and suggested that the
Employment Exchanges Act should be
amended to allow private employment
exchanges to provide jobs, placement
services to both private and public sector
establishments;
(b) if so, whether poor coverage of
employment exchances followed to capture
the chances in employment are the reasons
behind the proposal of the Commission;

(c) if so, whether Government have
considered the proposal made by the
Planning Commission in their mid-term
appraisal; and
(d) if so, by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?

Development of cottage industries in
Gujarat
3124. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal from the State Government
of Gujarat for the development of cottage
industries in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the action taken by Government
thereon;
(d) the total amount allocated to the
State for this purpose during each of the
last two years; and
(e) the growth rate of the cottage
industries in the State?
Projects financed by KVIC
3125. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of projects that can be
solely financed by KVIC through KVIB,
but need not have bank-links;
(b) the number of such projects that
had to be closed-down upto 31st March,
2005;
(c) the number of projects set up in the
years 2003-04 and 2004-05 under margin
money schemes in each State and Union
Territory and the number of people
involved in them; and
(d) the number of projects abandoned
by KVIC and the amount turned into non-
performing assets on this account upto
31st March, 2005?
Khadi production in Chhattisgarh
and Orissa
†3126. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of hand spun and hand
woven Khadi, Woolen and Silk Khadi
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

705
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
produced in Chhattisgarh and Orissa during
last three years;
(b) the quantity of mineral, forest crop,
agro and food, chemical and polymer, hand
made paper produced and manufactured
during the same period in both States
alongwith details of production in rural
engineering sector, State-wise;
(c) the assistance provided by Khadi
and Village Industries Commission each
year; and
(d) the names of said units of Khadi and
Rural Industry, quantity produced
alongwith the assistance provided?
Investment in nuclear energy
3127. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal/
project to invest more in nuclear energy
and to increase share of nuclear energy in
the economy's overall energy mix;
(b) if so, the steps taken in detail for
above and new project formulated, if any,
State-wise, as on today;
(c) if so, the details including present
share of nuclear energy in overall energy
mix, State-wise as on today;
(d) if so, whether there is any attempt
to opening up nuclear power generation
sector for participation by private players;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof including
private players shown interest to enter
nuclear energy sector and action taken?
Selection of new companies for power
generation
†3128. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that National
Thermal Power Corporation Limited is
being considered for entrusting the
responsibility of increasing power
generation in the field of atomic energy in
the country;
(b) if so, the facts thereof;
(c) whether Government have also
chosen other companies to be entrusted
with the responsibility in the field of atomic
energy; and
(d) if so, the names of such companies
and the criteria fixed for selection?
Share of nuclear energy
3129. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
open civilian nuclear energy facilities to
international inspection and safeguards;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if so, whether nuclear power field
will be open to foreign suppliers of nuclear
fuel to reactors and foreign investors;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if so, whether the domestic private
sector participation in the nuclear energy
programme will be allowed;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) the present share of nuclear energy
in overall energy mix and the cost of

706
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
production of nuclear energy, thermal
energy and hydro power, State-wise till
date?
Coal exploration

PRIME MINISTER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had asked the Coal India Ltd. to expand its
capacity of coal exploration;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c)  whether it is also a fact that the
demand for coal is likely to be increased by
